This guide will walk you through how to create a cluster user, grant a
to a user, revoke a role from a user, and finally drop a user. For details about cluster roles, refer to
The following example shows how to create a user with the username
. The username and password for the user must follow these rules:
Username: Must start with a letter and can only include uppercase or lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.
Password: Must be 8-64 characters long and must include three of the following: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters.

from pymilvus import MilvusClient

client = MilvusClient(
    uri="http://localhost:19530",
    token="root:Milvus"
)

export TOKEN="root:Milvus"

--header "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
--header "Content-Type: application/json" \

    "userName": "user_1",

        .uri("http://localhost:19530")

        .build();
